summary: 9 browser checks + 3 backend test files (8 pytest cases), all passing. 9 acceptance_matrix criteria covered (home hero/explorer counted as separate criteria, plus 1 public-preview smoke check).
action_items: Note (non-blocking): Contact/Referral/Admin-login forms and the home-page 3D explorer tabs ignore the FIRST click/submit right after navigation while the Three.js client bundle is still hydrating (confirmed via requestfinished listener showing zero network calls on the swallowed click, and a React hydration-mismatch console warning on the date input). A short settle wait (or a second click) after the page's heavy client JS mounts reliably works around it. Recommend main agent either guard interactive handlers until hydration completes or confirm this is acceptable dev-server behavior (briefing already flags slow first compiles).

checks.criterion: Cinematic 3D hero with headline and 3 CTAs
checks.name: home-hero-ctas
checks.evidence: hero-headline text matches, hero-3d-canvas visible, doctor card shows Dr. Girendra Shankar / MBBS, MD, FVIR, EBIR / Moti Nagar; hero-book-btn -> /contact#book, hero-refer-btn -> /referrals#refer, hero-explore-btn scrolls #explorer into view

checks.name: home-hero-public-preview
checks.evidence: Ran against https://delhi-vascular-ir--7t3oh8d2.preview.emergentagent.com - hero-headline, hero-3d-canvas, nav buttons all visible

checks.name: home-explorer-flagship-tabs
checks.evidence: All 6 explorer-tab-* testids present; clicking explorer-tab-evar and explorer-tab-aneurysm-coiling updates explorer-procedure-title accordingly

checks.name: explorer-full-controls
checks.evidence: 47 explorer-select-* rows; selecting evar updates title; step buttons change explorer-step-caption; prev/next, play-toggle, zoom in/out, rotate (aria-pressed true), labels (aria-pressed true), reset all clickable; compare normal/disease toggle aria-pressed correctly exclusive; doctor mode shows 'Access' text; consult/refer links visible

checks.name: explorer-deep-links
checks.evidence: /explorer/evar, /explorer/tips, /explorer/rfa-ablation, /explorer/vertebroplasty each render procedure-explorer with the matching explorer-select-* row highlighted (bg-teal class) and zero pageerror events

checks.name: all-nav-pages-reachable

checks.name: consult-form-submission
checks.evidence: Submitting with consent unchecked leaves consult-success absent; after checking consent, submit returns consult-success with reference matching /^CONS-[A-F0-9]{8}$/

checks.name: test_tscheck_consultation_form.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/consultations with valid tscheck- payload -> 201, reference starts with CONS-; same payload with consent:false -> 422

checks.criterion: Referral form with private imaging upload
checks.name: referral-form-submission
checks.evidence: Filled referral-* fields, attached tscheck-scan.pdf via referral-files-input (shown in referral-file-list), checked consent, submit -> referral-success with reference matching /^REF-[A-F0-9]{8}$/

checks.name: test_tscheck_referral_form.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/referrals with tscheck- payload + PDF -> 201, reference starts with REF-; same payload with .exe attachment -> 400; GET /api/admin/files/{id} without cookie -> 401

checks.name: admin-inbox-flow

checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_inbox.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/admin/counts|consultations|referrals without cookie -> 401; POST /api/admin/login wrong password -> 401; correct login + session cookie -> GET /api/admin/me 200, PATCH /api/admin/consultations/{id} status->reviewed 200, POST /api/admin/logout -> 204 (session is a stateless JWT so logout is a client-side cookie clear; the browser check covers the actual UI return-to-login behavior)
